cleaning.name: Empty dish rack and wipe counters (while coffee brews)
Squeegee shower and wipe sink (after shower)
10-min reset: dishes, cushions, quick vacuum (at log-off)
Wipe stove if you cooked, run dishwasher (before bed)
Bathroom (toilet, shower, mirror, floor) + change sheets and wash towels
Kitchen: microwave, appliance fronts, fridge purge
Monthly deep clean (~45 min): baseboards, vents, light fixtures, inside fridge, wash shower liner and bath mats, vacuum under furniture, dishwasher and washer clean cycles

intention.text: Let today be steady and unhurried: show up for the next small thing, then the next.
intention.journal: Where did I feel most like myself yesterday, and how can I make a little room for that today?
intention.ritual: Open a window for a few minutes while your coffee brews, and set one crystal or small object you love on your desk.

sketch.text: Sketch your gym shoes before the midday lift in a Wendy MacNaughton spirit: one slow continuous line, then a single wash of color (10 min).
